test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 19 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, Q, R, S, T, U and Y, are sitting in a row facing North (but not necessarily in the same order). Only four people sit between R and Q. S sits to the immediate left of Q. Only one person sits between S and Y. Y sits at some place to the left of T but at some place to the right of U. Who sits third from the left end of the line?
solution:
Given: Six people, Q, R, S, T, U and Y, are sitting in a row facing North.

1) Only four people sit between R and Q.

2) S sits to the immediate left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6169fcfab659db0c469358eea517964eb342be4ba054f6747c051c24804f8322.png] 

3) Only one person sits between S and Y.

4) Y sits at some place to the left of T but at some place to the right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9d908f33e19155068a43503f356def33ea79bfb9a04f8c0baf7abe195cdd604.png] 

Thus, Y sits third from the left end of the line.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
